entries.4992cd163fc75bd5: A company that, as the exclusive Japan general agent of the Brazilian agricultural cooperative CAMTA, imports, processes and sells frozen pulp of Amazon fruits such as açaí.
entries.8b19a3207fe6b37d: This is a business that imports and sells cacao beans, pepper and other products produced using agroforestry farming methods, and promotes overseas business expansion. It sells cacao beans produced by CAMTA to major food manufacturers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥60 million.
entries.9355a597952f1055: This is a business that sells frozen fruit pulp and processed products thereof to restaurants and food manufacturers, etc. For small restaurants, it operates the business-use mail-order site "FRUTA BIZ WEB", and also supplies acai and other ingredients for use in beverages, dairy products, confectionery and supplements. It also sells to sports gyms. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,364 million.
entries.c5003bddd4613f2d: The company is a single company headquartered in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, with no subsidiaries or affiliates. It operates a single segment, the import food manufacturing and sales business, and had 33 employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026. It is listed on the Growth Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.c9eedd8bcbacaf85: This is a business that sells to retailers such as mass-market stores and premium supermarkets, primarily using Amazon fruits such as acai, with products under its own brands and private-brand (PB) products. It handles refrigerated products such as the FRUTA ACAI series and frozen products such as acai frozen puree and "Ohie de Acai Bowl". Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,365 million.
